name: Survey tile in Pisces
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.7 degrees south of the ecliptic in Pisces, imaged by SPHEREx 13 times in 7 visits over 38 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 26 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 38 hours starting 2026-06-15, at wavelengths from 0.87 to 4.97 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
